[[File:Kenix_Kil.jpg|thumb|right|224px|The alias "Kenix Kil" was Imperial Guardsmen Kir Kanos' name in the Guard's battle language.]]
The '''Emperor's Royal Guard battle language''' was a [[Language/Legends|language]] understood only by the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]].

Due to the fact only [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Guardsmen]] understood it, it was fool-proof when sent on a comlink, as even if the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] decrypted the frequency, they couldn't find any phrase on any available database. Even [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] didn't understand it. After the majority of the Guard was [[Attack on the Imperial Royal Guard Academy|eliminated]], [[Kir Kanos]] used "Kenix Kil", an anagram of his name in the battle language, as an alias.

[[Tav Kennede]] was the only known non-guardsmen who knew the language.

==Known phrases==
*"Kenix Kil" (anagram of "Kir Kanos", used by Kanos as an alias.)
